inputs.net_debt_sign_convention: Positive = net debt (cash outflow item, subtracted from EV). Negative = net CASH (added to EV to reach equity value). net_debt_rmb_mn = total_debt (259,996) - [cash (131,530) + unrestricted short-term investments (155,236) + unrestricted other treasury investments (234,058)] = 259,996 - 520,824 = -260,828, i.e. a net CASH position of RMB 260,828M. Identical basis and figure to BABA_DCF.json (company-level balance sheet, listing-venue-agnostic).

historical_growth.fcf_cagr_note: FY2026 FCF was -RMB 46,609M (negative trough driven by RMB 126B AI capex and quick-commerce subsidies). Standard CAGR cannot be computed from a negative terminal value. FCF history FY2020-FY2026: [130,914; 172,662; 98,874; 171,663; 156,210; 73,870; -46,609] RMB M. FY2020-FY2025 average = RMB 134,032M. Normalized base = RMB 120,000M (10.5% haircut to reflect near-term capex overhang).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (2.5%) is far below Revenue 5yr CAGR (7.4%) and EPS 3yr CAGR (16.8%). Divergence is explained by: (1) massive share buybacks reducing equity per share denominator effects and reinvestment mix, (2) FY2026 investment cycle compressing retained earnings, (3) a corrected FY2017 equity base (278,799 RMB M, down from a previously overstated 566,578) that raises the LONGER-horizon (9yr, FY2017-FY2026) equity CAGR to 16.0% -- but this window is dominated by the initial low base and is not representative of steady-state compounding. Per the trough-FCF framework, equity CAGR is not used as the primary growth anchor -- FCF recovery trajectory is modeled explicitly by scenario. FCF CAGR is flagged N/A due to negative terminal year. (Identical to BABA_DCF.json -- company-level fundamentals, listing-venue-agnostic.)

Key corrections vs prior models: FY2017 equity corrected to 278,799 RMB M (was 566,578); FY2026 cash corrected to 131,530 and total debt to 259,996 RMB M; diluted weighted-avg shares FY2026 = 19,235M ordinary (~2,404.4M ADS). valuation_philosophy.approach: Trough-FCF Mid-Cycle Normalization with Exit-Multiple Cap (carried over unchanged from the corrected BABA/Reports/BABA_DCF.json, 2026-07-26)
valuation_philosophy.summary: FY2026 is an intentional investment trough -- not structural demand decline. Alibaba deployed RMB 126B in AI/cloud capex (part of a stated RMB 380B+ three-year programme, guided to potentially 'overshoot') and poured subsidies into Taobao Instant Commerce to compete with Meituan, collapsing FCF to a RMB 46,609M outflow. These are discretionary investment choices, and July 2026 developments (quick-commerce loss-per-order roughly halved from peak, guided ~50% cut in FY2027 quick-commerce investment, SAMR's June 2026 anti-subsidy rules, AIDC EBITA loss narrowing 96% YoY, Cloud Intelligence Group Q4 external revenue +40% turbocharged by the Apple Intelligence/Qwen partnership) all support a faster-than-previously-modeled recovery path. Anchoring the DCF base year on FY2026 reported FCF would systematically under-value the business. The model retains a NORMALIZED (mid-cycle) FCF base of RMB 120,000M for the base case: a ~10.5% discount to the FY2020-FY2025 average of RMB 134,032M, still reflecting continued elevated capex through FY2028 despite the encouraging de-escalation signals. Bull case RMB 138,000M (toward FY2024 actual FCF of 156,210M, reflecting the July 2026 Apple/Qwen catalyst and faster subsidy war resolution). Bear case RMB 68,000M (near-FY2025-trough but slightly below it, reflecting that geopolitical/legal tail risks -- DoD 1260H, Anthropic securities investigation -- could still reopen a deeper investment or legal-cost cycle). An exit-multiple cap (min of Gordon Growth TV vs EV/EBITDA cap on normalized EBITDA) prevents any scenario from implying multiples the market has never sustainably paid for BABA. This cap remains binding in the base and bull cases; Gordon Growth is more conservative and binds in the bear case. REVISED 2026-07-26 (re-synced from BABA): exit-multiple caps re-derived (down from 9.0/12.0/6.0 to 7.0/9.5/4.5) after correcting the historical EV/EBITDA series to net the full investment portfolio out of EV, not just cash. All figures are RMB, currency- and listing-venue-agnostic.

wacc_rationale.note: WACC held unchanged from BABA. Base 11.5% = 4.5% risk-free + 5.0% ERP + 1.5% China/VIE/regulatory + 0.5% Pentagon CMC + 0.5% Anthropic/securities litigation overhang. Bull case (10.5%) assumes geopolitical/legal risks resolve favorably (DoD case won on Xiaomi/AMEC precedent, no securities suit filed). Bear case (13.0%) assumes China-US tensions re-escalate, the Pentagon designation is upheld, and/or a securities class action is filed and gains traction. WACC is currency-agnostic (real cost of capital); applied identically in the RMB cash-flow build regardless of listing venue (HKEX vs NYSE). Not revised in the 2026-07-26 net-debt correction (balance-sheet-only fix).

exit_multiple_cap.ebitda_basis_note: Average of FY2023 (175,710), FY2024 (191,668), and FY2025 (202,325) Adjusted EBITDA -- representing Alibaba's EBITDA in non-trough years. Projected to Y5 at 60% of FCF growth rates per year, then multiplied by exit multiple. Terminal value = min(Gordon Growth TV, exit multiple TV). EBITDA basis itself is unchanged by the net-debt correction.
exit_multiple_cap.rationale: REVISED 2026-07-26 (re-synced from BABA): the prior historical EV/EBITDA series computed EV as market cap + total debt - cash only, omitting short-term investments and other treasury investments from the EV bridge -- the same error as the net-debt bridge, and it overstated every year's multiple by the same amount. Recomputed 10yr historical EV/EBITDA using FY-end market caps, corrected balance-sheet data, and EV = market cap + total debt - cash - short-term investments - other treasury investments (unrestricted/reported basis; FY2017-FY2018 lack short-term investment disclosure in our extracts, so those two years remain cash-only and are flagged as such -- they fall outside the FY2022-FY2025 calibration window regardless): FY2017 25.0x (cash-only), FY2018 27.7x (cash-only), FY2019 25.8x, FY2020 21.8x, FY2021 19.1x (bubble peak), FY2022 9.9x, FY2023 8.3x, FY2024 4.6x, FY2025 9.6x, FY2026 16.0x (trough-EBITDA distortion). This EV/EBITDA series is currency- and listing-venue-invariant (identical underlying RMB EV and RMB EBITDA), so it is identical to the corrected BABA series. The 'normal-year' (FY2022-FY2025) EV/EBITDA range is now 4.62x-9.94x with an average of ~8.12x -- materially lower than the prior (cash-only) estimate of 6.4x-12.2x / higher average, because a much larger cash-like buffer is now correctly removed from EV in every year. Base recalibrated to 7.0x (~89% of the 8.12x normal-year average). Bull recalibrated to 9.5x (~97% of the 9.94x normal-year high). Bear recalibrated to 4.5x (~97% of the 4.62x normal-year low). Exit cap remains binding in base and bull cases; Gordon Growth binds in the bear case. Current spot EV/EBITDA on normalized (avg FY23-25) EBITDA, using the corrected net-cash EV at HK$110.00, is ~8.2x -- within the corrected normal-year range, confirming the caps do not require multiple expansion beyond where the market already prices normalized BABA net of its full investment portfolio.

base.fcf_base_description: Normalized mid-cycle FCF; 10.5% discount to FY2020-FY2025 average of 134,032M to reflect continued AI capex through FY2028
base.growth_narrative: Y1 (+22%): FCF begins recovering as quick-commerce subsidies moderate (loss-per-order already halved from peak, guided ~50% FY2027 investment cut) and Cloud Intelligence Group AI revenue scales (external cloud revenue +40% in Q4 FY2026). Y2 (+18%): AIDC reaches break-even (EBITA loss already down 96% YoY in Q4 FY2026), removing a headwind. Y3-Y4 (+14%/+10%): capex intensity plateaus, incremental AI/Apple-driven cloud revenue flows to FCF at improving margin. Y5 (+7%): deceleration toward terminal growth as e-commerce matures. Re-synced 2026-07-26 to match the corrected BABA model (was 25/20/15/10/7 in the superseded 9988.HK build).

bull.fcf_base_description: Higher normalized base just below FY2024 actual FCF level (156,210M), reflecting faster cloud/AI monetization inflection catalyzed by the Apple/Qwen partnership
bull.growth_narrative: Faster cloud/AI commercialization following the July 2026 Apple Intelligence/Qwen deal: AI products reach 50%+ of external cloud revenue ahead of the ~1-year management target, and the Apple relationship expands. Quick commerce unit economics improve rapidly (positive by early FY2027) as SAMR rules take hold faster than expected. AIDC profitable in FY2027 per guidance. Anthropic securities investigation closes without a filed suit; DoD 1260H case resolved in Alibaba's favor. H200 chip access expands beyond the initial 75,000-unit cap. FCF recovers sharply. Re-synced 2026-07-26 (was FCF base 140,000 / growth 30/25/20/15/10 in the superseded build).

bear.fcf_base_description: Sustained suppression slightly below FY2025 actual level (73,870M): subsidy war re-escalates or legal/geopolitical risk deepens the investment/cost cycle
bear.growth_narrative: Subsidy war with Meituan re-escalates despite SAMR rules, or a renewed flare-up occurs given 'war without a clear winner' as of mid-2026. Rosen Law Firm securities investigation matures into a filed class action, and/or the DoD upholds the 1260H designation on appeal, triggering forced institutional selling and elevated legal costs. AI capex ROI disappoints despite the Apple deal; H200 access remains capped and insufficient for frontier-scale training. FCF recovers slowly from trough. E-commerce market share continues eroding to Douyin and PDD. Re-synced 2026-07-26 (was FCF base 70,000 / growth 5/5/3/3/2 in the superseded build). NOTE: BABA_DCF.json's assumptions.bear.growth_rates field displayed [5,4,3,3,2] but its actual bear FCF projections (72,080/75,684/78,711/81,073/82,694) were computed from growth path [6,5,4,3,2]% -- a labeling inconsistency in the source BABA file. This 9988.HK file carries the ACTUAL growth path used in the projections ([6,5,4,3,2]%) for internal consistency between the assumptions and the projections/Excel model.

Compares to current EV/EBITDA(normalized) of ~8.2x at HK$110.00 -- close to, modestly above today's implied multiple, i.e. the base case assumes only slight multiple expansion, consistent with the corrected, more conservative 7.0x exit cap.

entry_price.note: REVISED 2026-07-26: Entry price = ( sum(FCF_t / 1.15^t, t=1..5) + Gordon_TV_5 / 1.15^5 + net_cash ) / 19,235 ordinary shares x CNYHKD 1.1597. Gordon TV (not the exit-multiple-capped TV) is used as the fair year-5 exit value the buyer sells into, consistent with the entry-price methodology (WACC-based Gordon TV represents the price a subsequent buyer pays; only the discounting back to today uses the 15% hurdle). Net cash (260,828 RMB M) is ADDED to the bridge (the superseded file incorrectly subtracted a net-debt figure of 128,466). All values in HKD per HK ordinary share.

base.interpretation: Base case entry (HK$137.69) is 25.2% ABOVE the current price of HK$110.00 (negative 'discount' denotes entry above current). The net-cash correction raises the entry price materially versus the superseded pre-correction figure of HK$110.64, because the large unrestricted investment portfolio (RMB 520,824M in liquid/near-liquid assets) is real value a buyer receives today, on top of the interim FCF and Gordon terminal value. This means a 15%-IRR buyer can pay meaningfully more than today's price and still clear the hurdle -- consistent with base intrinsic value (HK$126.99) also sitting above the current price. The stock is inexpensive enough in the base case that today's price already implies a forward IRR to base-case fair value comfortably above 15%.

bull.interpretation: Bull case entry (HK$207.26) is 88.4% above current price. If the bull scenario materializes (Apple/Qwen driven cloud re-rating, faster quick-commerce breakeven, favorable legal resolutions), the current price of HK$110.00 provides a large margin of safety relative to the 15%-CAGR entry point, now that the full investment portfolio is correctly credited to the equity bridge.

bear.interpretation: Bear case implies severe downside (-46.8% intrinsic value loss from current price). A HK$55.55 entry price would be required for a 15% CAGR in the bear scenario -- 49.5% below current market price. Even after crediting the full net-cash position, this scenario still requires multiple catastrophic risks (subsidy war re-escalation, adverse DoD ruling, filed securities class action, AI capex disappointment) to materialize simultaneously for the downside to be this severe -- the large cash buffer provides a meaningful floor under the bear case relative to the superseded model (HK$32.40).

sensitivity.basis: REVISED 2026-07-26: Base case FCF = RMB 120,000M, growth rates Y1-Y5 = [22%, 18%, 14%, 10%, 7%], exit multiple cap recalibrated to 7.0x normalized EBITDA (down from 9.0x), net cash of RMB 260,828M added to the equity bridge. Underlying RMB values identical to BABA_DCF.json; converted to HKD per HK ordinary share via /19,235 ordinary shares x CNYHKD 1.1597.
sensitivity.matrix_note: With the recalibrated 7.0x exit multiple cap (TV = RMB 1,996,247M, fixed across the matrix), the exit cap is now binding at EVERY WACC/terminal-growth combination in the tested range -- Gordon Growth TV exceeds the exit-multiple TV even at the lowest WACC (9.5%) and lowest terminal growth (2.0%) tested. This is a direct consequence of lowering the cap from 9.0x to 7.0x following the corrected (lower) historical EV/EBITDA range. As a result, each row is fully flat across terminal growth, and value varies only with WACC (via the discount factor applied to the fixed exit-multiple TV and the PV of interim FCF). This is an honest byproduct of the corrected, more conservative cap -- terminal growth assumptions are effectively irrelevant to the base-case valuation once the exit-multiple discipline binds this tightly. Row-3 (WACC 11.5%) value of HK$126.98 differs from the headline base-case intrinsic value of HK$126.99 only due to rounding of intermediate compounding steps.

probability_weighted.weight_rationale: Weights held unchanged from the corrected BABA model. 25% bear: meaningful but non-dominant probability that legal/geopolitical overhangs (unresolved DoD 1260H litigation, newly active Anthropic securities investigation, subsidy war re-escalation risk) deepen rather than resolve. 50% base: most likely path -- gradual FCF normalization over FY2027-FY2029 as cloud scales (Apple/Qwen deal reinforcing this), quick-commerce losses moderate per management guidance, and legal risks neither fully resolve nor escalate. 25% bull: AI monetization inflects faster than guided (Apple deal expands, cloud run-rate exceeds targets), and the DoD/securities overhangs resolve favorably. The net-debt correction raises the weighted IV from the superseded HK$121.82 to HK$123.85 (+1.7%) despite the lower exit-multiple caps and the re-synced (mostly lower base-year, but higher bull growth) FCF paths, because the RMB 260,828M net-cash addition to the equity bridge outweighs the reduction in exit-multiple-implied terminal value in every scenario where the exit cap binds.

implied_multiples.note: REVISED 2026-07-26: Computed at current price HK$110.00 (RMB 94.85/share at CNYHKD 1.1597), with EV now correctly netting the full unrestricted investment portfolio, not cash alone. EV/EBITDA on trough FY2026 EBITDA (RMB 113,483M) = 13.78x (down from 17.3x in the superseded model) -- flagged as a trough-year outlier, not a representative sanity bound (denominator is depressed by the intentional FY2026 investment cycle). Correct comparison uses normalized EBITDA (avg FY2023-FY2025 = RMB 189,901M): 8.23x, DOWN from the superseded model's 10.3x and now comfortably within (not at the top of) the corrected normal-year range of 4.62x-9.94x. P/E (17.25x) and P/B (1.72x) / P/S (1.78x) are essentially unchanged from the superseded figures (they were never distorted by the net-debt error, since they don't involve EV) -- small differences vs the prior 9988.HK file (17.9x/1.73x/1.79x) reflect the updated FY2026 diluted EPS basis (RMB 5.50) and rounding, not a methodology change.

historical_averages.series_methodology: REVISED 2026-07-26: EV/EBITDA series is currency- and listing-venue-INVARIANT (identical underlying RMB EV and RMB EBITDA regardless of whether market cap is derived from the NYSE ADS price or the HKEX ordinary-share price), so it is carried over IDENTICALLY from the corrected BABA_DCF.json series. Computed from FY-end closing prices, CSV per-year EPS_Diluted, ShareholdersEquity_RMB_Mn, AdjustedEBITDA_RMB_Mn, TotalDebt/CashAndEquivalents, and ShortTermInvestments_RMB_Mn/OtherTreasuryInvestments_RMB_Mn from 9988.HK_Metrics.csv (columns confirmed present; treasury investments are zero before FY2023, consistent with Alibaba's treasury-investment program starting later in the historical window). EV = market cap + total debt - cash - short-term investments - other treasury investments (previously: market cap + total debt - cash only). FY2017-FY2018 lack short-term/other-treasury-investment data in the CSV; those two years are computed on a cash-only net-debt basis (identical to the prior series) and flagged -- they sit outside the FY2022-FY2025 calibration window used for exit-multiple caps regardless, so this data gap does not affect the caps. FY2026 uses the MD&A 'unrestricted for withdrawal and use' figures (155,236 / 234,058) for full consistency with the DCF inputs; the CSV's FY2026 ShortTermInvestments/OtherTreasuryInvestments columns carry the gross balance-sheet figures (155,310/238,075) -- the small resulting difference (net cash 260,828 MD&A basis vs 264,919 balance-sheet basis) is immaterial to the multiple (16.02x MD&A basis vs 16.0x balance-sheet basis, rounds the same).

recent_normal_years_fy2022_fy2025.note: Post-antitrust-overhaul, pre-FY2026-trough years (FY2022-FY2025) are the most relevant comparison set for a mid-cycle Alibaba, excluding both the FY2021 bubble peak and the FY2026 capex/subsidy trough. REVISED 2026-07-26: EV/EBITDA range and average recomputed netting the full investment portfolio -- materially lower than the superseded (cash-only) figures.

sanity_check.diagnosis: REVISED 2026-07-26: No hard sanity trip on normalized multiples, and the corrected picture is, if anything, MORE conservative than the superseded model on the EV/EBITDA dimension even though intrinsic value per share is higher. P/B 1.72x at current price is within the recent-normal-years (FY2022-FY2025) range of 1.35x-2.30x and below the period average of ~1.88x. Normalized EV/EBITDA at current price is 8.23x, comfortably within the corrected recent-normal-years range of 4.62x-9.94x, versus 10.3x in the superseded model which sat closer to the (higher, less accurate) prior ceiling. P/E 17.25x (on trough FY2026 EPS, understating true earnings power) sits below the recent-years average of 22.6x. P/S 1.78x is within the recent range. Base case upside (15.4% on IV; 12.6% probability-weighted) does not trigger any 'excessive upside at elevated price' trip -- 9988.HK at HK$110.00 remains well below FY2018-2021 peak multiples and below sell-side price targets. Net effect of the re-sync and net-debt correction: base and bear intrinsic value rose materially (base +$(126.99-127.66)... actually base IV moved from HK$127.66 to HK$126.99, essentially flat / -0.5%, because the re-synced base growth path [22/18/14/10/7] is slightly LESS aggressive than the superseded [25/20/15/10/7] path, which almost exactly offsets the net-cash addition's uplift; bear IV rose sharply from HK$35.42 to HK$58.56 (+65.3%) because the net-cash addition dominates a modestly higher bear FCF base/growth path; bull IV fell slightly from HK$196.54 to HK$182.86 (-7.0%) because the lower bull exit cap (9.5x vs 12.0x) outweighs both the net-cash addition and the slightly lower bull FCF base (138,000 vs 140,000).
sanity_check.fix_applied: Exit multiple cap applied as a precautionary discipline even though no hard trip was triggered. REVISED 2026-07-26: caps recalibrated to 7.0x/9.5x/4.5x (base/bull/bear) from 9.0x/12.0x/6.0x, following the corrected (lower) historical EV/EBITDA range once the investment portfolio is properly netted out of EV. Base case 7.0x exit multiple on normalized EBITDA constrains base IV to HK$126.99. Bull case 9.5x cap constrains bull IV to HK$182.86, down from the superseded HK$196.54, reflecting the more conservative bull ceiling. The cap ensures no scenario implies EV/EBITDA meaningfully above what the market has paid in normal (non-bubble, non-trough) years, now measured on a fully-netted EV basis. Adjusted base used throughout (sensitivity, entry price, probability-weighted IV).
special_context: FY2026 is a deliberate investment trough -- anchoring on reported FCF (-46,609 RMB M) would produce systematic under-valuation. Mid-cycle normalization is methodologically correct, and July 2026 operating data (halved loss-per-order, guided ~50% FY2027 quick-commerce investment cut, AIDC near-breakeven, Cloud +40%) corroborates that the recovery is already underway.

WACC 11.5% incorporates ~2.5pp China/VIE/regulatory/litigation premium above a US-listed comparable, applied identically regardless of HKEX vs NYSE listing venue. This remains the primary valuation lever -- if the DoD 1260H litigation resolves favorably and the Anthropic securities investigation does not mature into a filed suit, true WACC could fall toward 9.5-10.5% and base IV would rise further per the sensitivity matrix (though note the matrix is now WACC-driven only, since the exit cap binds across the full terminal-growth range tested).

The live FX conversion (CNYHKD 1.1597, derived from USDHKD 7.8414 / USDCNY 6.7617, both live as of 2026-07-26) mechanically raises all HKD-converted values relative to the superseded model's implicit FX basis -- this is a real economic effect (RMB translation), not a modeling artifact, and is layered on top of (not instead of) the underlying operating assumptions.

EPS-based P/E multiples remain an imperfect anchor for BABA/9988.HK: FY2026 diluted EPS (RMB 5.50) is still depressed by the investment cycle even though it improved from FY2025 levels; normalized run-rate earnings power is materially higher once quick-commerce losses fully abate and cloud operating leverage compounds.
